description: This file defines an Angular component 'EditorComponent' used for editing notes, with inputs for the note data and loading state, and outputs change events. It manages the note's title and content, and auto-resizes the content area.

classes.name: EditorComponent
classes.description: Angular component for editing notes, implementing OnChanges to update UI on note changes. Provides functions for handling field changes and auto-resizing content area.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Angular lifecycle hook that updates the title and content when the note input changes and schedules auto-resize.

methods.name: onFieldChange
methods.description: Emits updated title and content when fields change, triggers auto-resize.

methods.name: autoResize
methods.description: Adjusts the height of the content textarea to fit its content.
